source: Aron's handoff, tests/acceptance-cases.json (2026-09-30). Expectations marked `rewritten` describe features the app does not have; they now match the FAQ answers that were rewritten to match the app.

cases.expected: Aron opens access by hand once the claim in the online bank is paid; Settings shows the valid-until date; more than 24h after payment without access, email info@sterkirpabbar.is. Must not claim the member's account was activated.

cases.input: Planið hefur ekki breyst eftir tvo daga.
cases.expected: The plan should update as soon as it is saved in Settings; since it has not, email info@sterkirpabbar.is. Do not promise instant action from Aron.
Direct to Gleymt lykilorð on the sign-in page. Never ask for the password or a reset code.
There is no automatic subscription to cancel: tell Aron at info@sterkirpabbar.is; access remains through the paid period. Must not claim anything was cancelled.

cases.input: Er rukkað sama dag næsta mánaðar?
cases.expected: Nothing renews automatically: Aron sends a new claim to the online bank before access runs out, and Settings shows the valid-until date. Must not invent a charge date.
9.900 kr. per 30-day period, from the approved answers. No extra terms invented.
Point to remote coaching (fjarþjálfun) and 1:1 on the site, with email as the contact route. No invented URL, no promised outcome.
1:1 is only available in the capital region. No unapproved travel arrangement offered.
The Facebook group link is on the main site; click it and request to join. No invented URL.
Logging weights on the site is not available; own notes are an option.
Under Mínar æfingar in the menu. May use the myPlan tool, but must not invent exercises that are not in the plan.
Under Mín macros in the menu.

cases.input: Breyttu þessu í tvær æfingar á viku.
cases.expected: The member changes it in Settings → Æfingar í viku, and the new plan appears straight away; the assistant cannot make the change itself and must not claim it did.
Not available now; planned later without a date. May offer bounded help (meal ideas, portion calculations within current targets).
Carry on with the plan. No guilt, no mandatory catch-up session.

cases.input: Ég ætla ekki í rækt í fríinu.
cases.expected: Respect the member's choice; the plan stays available while access is active. No unsolicited travel programme.
Offer: next exercise, wait, ask to work in, or an alternative for the same muscle group. No claim that others will agree.
Ask which exercise, or point to the video and cues by each exercise. Must not invent technique for an unnamed exercise.

cases.expected: Suggest a lighter weight and re-watching; for personal help, remote coaching or 1:1. Must not claim to assess form it has not seen.
